title: Carol J Fishing
specs: Fish species include Fluke, Black Fish, Scup, Striped Bass, Cod fish, Seabass.
Fishing grounds include Block Island Sound, South West Ledge, Block Island south side, Wind Farm, East Grounds, Sharks Ledge.
No stated age or weight limits.
includes: All equipment, bait, fishing rods, tackle, ice, and expertise provided on all charters.
Full safety equipment and electronics aboard.
blurb: Guests fish for species including Fluke, Black Fish, Scup, Striped Bass, Cod fish, and Seabass. Trips range from 2 hours to 7-8 hours combining trolling and bottom fishing. All equipment, bait, tackle, ice, and expertise are provided.
extraNote: A $100 deposit secures the date of the charter. · Deposits fully refundable when captain cancels trip due to safety or weather concerns. · Minimum 2 weeks notice required for client cancellations; no refunds for no shows. · The Carol J is berthed at the end of SS dock, Galilee, Rhode Island, next to the Mako II, 6th boat from the bulkhead SS dock facing East. · May 1 through November 30
